records.subject: LiTFSI post-treatment
records.quote: Herein, a flexible and foldable film of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrene sulfonate)/single-walled carbon nanotube (PEDOT:PSS/SWCNT) composite is fabricated by post-treatment with an ionic liquid (IL), and an S-shape TE generator (TEG) is designed to harvest heat from human body via a vertical temperature gradient.
